summary: Fixed last/best checkpoint mismatch fallback policy by marking candidate unverified if best file is missing.
Enforced mandatory full-seed re-acceptance for selected checkpoints and bound metrics to checkpoint SHA256 and contract version.
Added robust transactional artifact staging and rollback with explicit atomic file replace behavior and proper commit_error reporting.
Corrected restart/episode boundary initialization and marked warm restart replay/env RNG limitations explicitly.
Added lifecycle guards to prevent success bonus and steps after terminal/truncated states.
Expanded parity test coverage with valid binary maps/scalars, all-covered/blocked/no-target cases, and nonfinite forward/ORT checks.
limitations: No actual physical hardware or ROS training executed.
Warm restart does not fully restore replay buffer contents or exact environment internal RNG sequences.
